description: This PHP class 'Subordinate' extends ListableDisplayField and is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the reporting module for displaying subordinate employee information. It defines methods for retrieving the DTO class, relevant fields, and entity aliases used in reporting.

classes.name: Subordinate
classes.description: Represents a subordinate display field in the report, extending ListableDisplayField to provide subordinate-specific DTO class, fields, and entity aliases.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the DTO used for subordinate data in reports.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the list of database fields that this display field will include, specifically 'employee.empNumber'.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the aliases for entities used in queries, here 'subordinate'.
